title: feat: add nomic-player Jev voting code agent
author: ammarelshaf3y
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15723

Adds `apps/agent-nomic-player/`: a code agent where Jev votes on Nomic proposals and a text model argues the verdict. No other submission plays the shared Nomic game.

- One real Jev decision per run (`POST /alpha/decisions`, `choice` yes/no with probabilities, caller pays). The agent never overrides Jev; the text model only writes the argument.
- Trace `[nomic-player: jev voted <choice> {...}]` prepended on both `/v1/responses` and `/v1/chat/completions` (full terminal envelope with real usage).
- Copy of deployed code + README + static checks (5/5) + live demos under `apps/agent-nomic-player/`.

Source repo (public, `agent.ts` at root): https://github.com/ammarelshaf3y/nomic-player
Deployed agent ID / callable model: `3b37b51a-32c5-4bbb-a27b-355cf00d6bed` / `community/ammarelshaf3y/nomic-player` (private).

Three live runs, different Jev verdicts with probabilities (full log in `demos/demo.md`):
1. Strict proverb rule -> NO (yes 0.47 / no 0.53).
2. Public named vote records -> NO (yes 0.05 / no 0.95).
3. Herald reads summaries aloud -> YES (no 0.39 / yes 0.61).

Alpha feedback: code-agent terminal responses need a full envelope (id/object/created/model/status/usage) or the gateway 502s; `agents create` does not deploy, a manual `sync` is required, and the sync validator typechecks strictly (unused params fail).

gist.headline: Jev gets the deciding vote
gist.blurb: ammarelshaf3y built a Nomic-playing code agent that lets Jev cast the vote, then asks a text model to make the case. The argument can be eloquent; the ballot stays Jev’s.
gist.summary: ammarelshaf3y added `apps/agent-nomic-player/`, a code agent that makes one paid Jev yes/no decision with probabilities per Nomic proposal, then uses a text model to argue—but never override—the verdict.
gist.impact: The agent’s `/v1/responses` and `/v1/chat/completions` outputs prepend a trace of Jev’s vote, so each argument shows the decision and its probabilities.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the community-built Nomic player as a cozy voting desk: a CRT terminal records Jev’s yes/no ballot and probabilities while a friendly monitor robot writes the argument. Polli, wearing a tiny clerk’s visor, watches the ballot go into the box; code-plants and flowers frame the scene. No invented Jev mascot or logo.
